sloka: तम् मत्त मातङ्ग विलास गामी  गच्छन्तम् अव्यग्र मनाः महात्मा ।स लक्ष्मणो राघवम् अप्रमत्तो ररक्ष धर्मेण बलेन च एव ॥४-१-१२७॥
transliteration: tam matta mātaṅga vilāsa gāmī  gacchantam avyagra manāḥ mahātmā ।sa lakṣmaṇo rāghavam apramatto rarakṣa dharmeṇa balena ca eva ॥4-1-127॥

translations.english: The great soul, Lakshmana, striding like a mighty elephant, with a steady mind, followed Rama dutifully, protecting him with his strength.
